explanation: Track used digits for every row, column and subgrid. Repeatedly choose an empty cell with the fewest legal candidates, try each candidate, and undo failed choices. Only initially empty cells are assigned, preserving clues.
timeComplexity: Exponential search: at most O(n^e) branches for e empty cells on an n by n board, with O(n³) candidate scanning per search node.
spaceComplexity: O(n squared + n times e) auxiliary space for used-digit tables, recursion and candidate lists retained by up to e frames on an n by n board.
attribution: JavaScript port of the independently authored EPI Practice C# algorithm; no upstream reference code copied.
